bulletin_message.00:
Excuse me, fine fellows of this settlement. Sir Beacon here, with some news to share!
It's your lucky day! For you see, off in the distance these lands are being protected by other well developed kingdoms. We share the task of defending against wandering monsters, and fight in the Goblin and Orc wars.

I send messages all around, so I'll tell you about our developed system.

msg1.choice_000: They are kind to help us

bulletin_message.00:
Right now is your first Battle Break, which you can use to develop your town, safely. Lots of time to craft and build.
But I'm giving you some of our beacon flags (Battle Ready Beacons), and if I see them placed here, it lets me know that you are ready for fighting your own battles! The other kingdoms can then have their own break, by storing away their flags.

"When you want another Battle Break, just grab the flag, and put it away in storage until next time."

When it is placed in the world,
it signals that you are ready for
periodic random attacks by
monsters and wild invaders.

When it is placed in the world,
it signals that you are ready for
periodic attacks launched by
organized war camps, if they have arrived.
